links.outcome: LLM abstention when uncertain on medical multiple-choice questions
links.effect: Even state-of-the-art, high-accuracy open- and closed-source LLMs often fail to abstain when uncertain; explicit abstention options increased uncertainty and safer abstention; scaling and advanced prompting gave little improvement.
links.quote: Our systematic evaluation of both open- and closed-source LLMs reveals that even state-of-the-art, high-accuracy models often fail to abstain with uncertain.

unlisted_practices: Providing explicit abstention options in LLM prompts to increase safe abstention
Conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification and abstention in medical LLMs

screen.practice: explicit abstention option with conformal prediction
screen.reason: Evaluates explicit abstention mechanisms/options and conformal prediction as safety guardrails for medical LLMs under uncertainty on a benchmark dataset.

primary.practice: explicit abstention option and conformal prediction
